title: Senior Quality Analyst (Automation & Manual)
description:
Job Title: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Testing) – Senior Automation QA & Manual Testing

Experience: 8+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Dept: FSD

Designation: Senior Specialist – FSD QA

Location: Hybrid

About Us

At InxiteOut Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in building next-generation AI-powered applications that solve real-world business problems. We are expanding our QA team to ensure our AI systems are robust, secure, and aligned with user expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Strong knowledge of Python.
* Configure and test AI/ML product/system.
* Lead the quality assurance strategy and establish automation frameworks from scratch.
* Manage and mentor junior QA engineers and guide them in test automation and AI system validation.
* Own functional and non-functional testing across complex distributed systems.
* Own API, integration, acceptance, system, and end-to-end (E2E) testing.
* Lead test planning, test case design, and execution for web, API, and AI-based systems.
* Design and maintain regression test suites and ensure full coverage.
* Collaborate with Full Stack Developers, Data Scientists, and AI Engineers to define test strategies for LLM-based features.
* Own testing of AI-specific behaviors including:

o Hallucination and factual accuracy

o Consistency in prompt-response pairs

o Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) flows

* Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers in Agile teams.

Must-Have Skills

* Deep experience in Functional Testing:

o Advanced REST API Testing (Postman, REST Assured, etc.)

o Integration, Acceptance, E2E, Smoke, Sanity, System Testing

* Strong foundation in Non-Functional Testing:

o Performance and Load Testing

o Stress and Security Testing

* Proficiency in Testing Methods:

o Black-box, White-box, Grey-box Testing

* Regression Testing lifecycle ownership
* Expertise in automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, TestNG)
* Strong scripting/coding skills in Python (preferable) / Java / JavaScript
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

Good-to-Have (AI Testing Focus)

* Exposure to testing AI/ML products/systems.
* Experience of integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps etc.).
* Hands-on experience with AI testing tools or custom frameworks.
* Familiarity with evaluating LLM (large language model) outputs.
* Experience of validating RAG-based architecture.
* Understanding of hallucination detection metrics and prompt tuning.
* Exposure to safety audits for AI applications.
* Collaboration experience with Full Stack, Data Science, Data Engineering & DevOps teams.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications in testing or security are a plus (e.g., ISTQB, OWASP).

title: Founding Electrical, Electronics & Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Electrical, Electronics & Automation Engineer to join a confidential research, invention and manufacturing initiative being developed under Glamaxia.

The initiative involves developing a novel technology-driven physical product that will require the integration of electrical systems, electronic components, motion control, sensors, automation and intelligent data acquisition.

As part of the founding engineering team, you will participate in developing the electronic and control architecture of the product, integrating hardware components, building functional systems and testing their performance.

This is a rare opportunity for an aspiring engineer to participate in an invention and product-development process from its early stages, rather than joining an established manufacturing setup where the core engineering architecture has already been defined.

You will collaborate directly with the Founder and mechanical engineering team to bring the proposed system from concept to functional prototype.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in electrical and electronic research, system design and product development.
* Develop electrical architecture, wiring diagrams, circuit layouts and hardware integration plans.
* Assist in selecting suitable motors, motor drivers, controllers, sensors, encoders and electronic components.
* Work on motion control, automation, speed regulation, positioning and feedback systems.
* Develop and integrate embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware communication interfaces.
* Work with sensor systems, data acquisition, signal processing and real-time monitoring.
* Contribute to the development of control panels, power distribution and electrical protection systems.
* Explore hardware-to-software communication and IoT-based monitoring capabilities.
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers to integrate electrical and electronic components into physical assemblies.
* Assist in developing hardware prototypes, testing circuits, troubleshooting and performance validation.
* Maintain technical documentation, circuit diagrams, firmware records, test results and system configurations.
* Ensure appropriate attention to electrical protection, emergency controls, interlocks and operational safety.

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

**Educational Background**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering or Mechatronics.
* Diploma holders with relevant technical knowledge and hands-on experience may also apply.

*Fresh graduates with strong fundamentals, practical projects or embedded-systems experience are encouraged to apply.*

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Understanding of electrical circuits, AC/DC systems, power distribution and electrical protection.
* Familiarity with motors, motor drivers, servo systems, stepper motors, encoders and variable-frequency drives.
* Knowledge of PLCs, industrial automation, motion control and feedback systems.
* Familiarity with sensors, signal conditioning, data acquisition and measurement systems.
* Hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or similar embedded platforms.
* Programming knowledge in Embedded C, C++ or Python will be an advantage.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus or MQTT.
* Exposure to PCB design, circuit simulation, MATLAB/Simulink or LabVIEW is desirable.
* Knowledge of IoT, hardware-software integration and real-time monitoring systems will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with hardware synchronisation, timing systems and electronic safety mechanisms is desirable.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have a genuine interest in electronics, automation, robotics and applied engineering.
* Enjoy building and testing hardware rather than working exclusively on theoretical designs.
* Are curious about integrating electronic systems with mechanical engineering.
* Want to participate in the development of a new technology-driven product.
* Are comfortable experimenting with hardware, troubleshooting and learning through practical implementation.
* Can take ownership of technical assignments and work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Are excited by the challenges of early-stage research, invention and product development.

*Freshers with strong academic fundamentals, embedded-system projects, robotics experience, automation projects or personal hardware experiments are encouraged to apply. Candidates with practical industry experience are equally welcome.*

**What You Can Expect**

* An opportunity to join a founding engineering and invention team.
* Hands-on experience in electrical system development, electronics, embedded engineering and automation.
* Exposure to hardware architecture, component integration, prototyping and testing.
* Practical collaboration with mechanical engineering and software development professionals.
* Direct involvement in solving real-world engineering challenges.
* An opportunity to contribute to the design and development of a novel physical product.
* The potential to grow alongside the initiative as it progresses towards advanced product development and manufacturing.
* You will have the opportunity to participate in the creation of a new engineering system, learn across disciplines and contribute to an invention from its earliest development stages.

**Application**

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with a brief introduction to their technical interests and relevant academic, personal or professional projects.

Candidates are encouraged to share embedded-system projects, circuit designs, automation projects, robotics work, prototypes, GitHub repositories or other relevant technical portfolios.

**Join us in engineering what has not been built before.**

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description – QA Automation Engineer

**Company:** Cognizant  
**Job Title:** QA Automation Engineer  
**Experience:** 1–4 Years  
**Industry:** Information Technology (IT)

Job Summary

Cognizant is a global professional services and technology company providing IT consulting, digital engineering, cloud, data, and business solutions.

We are looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and manual test cases to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications. The candidate will collaborate with development and business teams to identify defects, maintain automation frameworks, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and Java.
* Perform functional, regression, and manual testing of software applications.
* Design and execute test cases based on business and technical requirements.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects using JIRA.
* Perform API testing to validate application functionality and integrations.
* Execute SQL queries for database testing and data validation.
* Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks.
* Participate in test planning, test-case design, and requirement analysis.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to resolve issues.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect reports, and quality metrics.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and follow established testing standards.
* Ensure application quality through continuous testing and regression validation.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent field.
* 1–4 years of experience in QA, software testing, or test automation.
* Strong knowledge of Selenium WebDriver and Java.
* Experience with TestNG and automation test script development.
* Understanding of manual, functional, and regression testing.
* Hands-on experience with API testing and SQL database testing.
* Familiarity with JIRA for defect tracking and test management.
* Knowledge of Git for version control.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and software development life cycles.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Required Technical Skills

* Selenium
* Java
* TestNG
* Automation Testing
* Manual Testing
* API Testing
* SQL
* Git
* JIRA
* Regression Testing
* Agile Methodology
* Test Case Design

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
